messages:
maria: Heads-up — compliance asked for a way to link "who changed what" to rollouts and make it downloadable. Thinking: per-change stable anchor that can point to rollout + diff + actor, and a downloadable bundle for audits. Can we scope to routing policies first?

jon: +1. We need a stable change_id emitted from the policy service. Proposal for event shape (rough):

```
{ "change_id": "uuid", "actor": "user:alice", "actor_id": "u-123", "timestamp": "2024-11-29T10:22:00Z", "resource": "routing-policy:rp-42", "action": "update", "diff_ref": "s3://audit/bundles/rp-42/change-uuid.diff", "rollout_id": "ro-987", "meta": { "env": "prod" }}
```

This lets console link to `/rollouts/ro-987` and export ndjson bundles.

lee: retention + PII concerns — exports must support pseudonymization or hashed actor ids. Also need admin-only mapping for full actor resolution (enterprise only).

sanjay: emitting full diffs for every minor change will spike ES storage and telemetry cost. Suggest: compact diff in hot index, full diff to cold storage (S3) and only include `diff_ref` in the event. Add sampling for non-critical orgs.

alice: UX idea: show a small "change" pill next to a policy row with who/when. Clicking opens a right-hand panel: diff (compact), linked rollout, download bundle button (radio: full/redacted). Hover shows quick preview. :eyes:

jon: For streaming exports: NDJSON gzipped bundles signed with a bundle id. We should attach `associated_rollouts: [ro-987]` to event to handle multiple rollouts. Do we prefer `/audit/events` or pushing to kafka? We can support both.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout started for routing-policy-service, canary id=1234, at 2024-11-29T10:23:45Z

lee: Assignments: jon -> event schema + storage plan, alice -> console mock + copy, sanjay -> telemetry quota + sampling plan, maria -> product acceptance & export UX. Also need legal sign-off for actor mapping.

sanjay: also request: add per-org audit-export quota and throttling; exports can be heavy.

alice: I'll sketch the panel and the download flow this afternoon, will post mock in #design. pinging @maria for acceptance criteria.

jon: will post a PR with schema + example ndjson bundle layout tomorrow.

maria: great. Action items: PR with schema, small migration plan (s3 path for diffs), add `change_id` to policy service, and console anchor implementation for routing policies MVP. Target: next sprint. :thumbsup:
